_help: One entry per customer. folder: the part after /Kaart/ in the links (a-z, 0-9 and -), or "" for the main address (your own installation). endpoint: the web app address the customer sends you (ends with /exec). defaultCardId: the card ID that is used when a link has none. version: "latest" (every update straight away) or a fixed version such as "v2.17.0" (stays on that version until you change it).
